Continuous Exposure of Your Car To UV Radiation (SUN) is Badly Affecting Your Car Dashboard, Upholstery (Car seats), Damaging Electrical Components, and Most Especially, affecting Your Health...

Read this till the very end to save you of the problems associated with UltraViolet Radiation, Very Important!!!...

Dear Friend,

It’s a fact that excessive sun exposure harms the human skin. Similarly, UV radiation can damage your car’s interior.


When the car is left under the sun for a considerable period, temperatures can rise to 145 degrees Fahrenheit. Contrary to what many car owners think, the seats and dashboard are not the only interior components that are prone to UV radiation, your health as well and that of your kids.

Hence, it is now advisable to use the RetractShield to Prevent UV Radiation into your car.

This is How UV Rays (SUN) is Damaging Your Car...

  • Leaves the dashboard looking Faded - The potent combination of UV radiation from the sun and the extreme heat that builds up inside the car can significantly damage the dashboard. Repairing such damage is expensive because you will be forced to replace most dashboard components.
  • Upholstery Issues - With continued UV exposure, your car’s upholstery may begin to deteriorate. If you have leather seat upholstery, for instance, excess heat and sunlight dry out natural oils contained in the leather. They will start to dry out, stiffen, and crack.
  • Rubber Weather Stripping Damage - Although they are not interior car components per se, the rubber weather stripping around the doors keep the interior habitable. The stripping prevents water, dust, air, and debris from entering the cabin, thus guaranteeing the comfort of car occupants.

    When exposed to the sun, your car’s rubber weather stripping can suffer from sun rot.
  • Damages Electrical Components - Your car’s electrical components are susceptible to damage if left exposed to unfiltered UV rays over a significant period. These include the radio, navigation system, and electrical connections under the dashboard or even on the floor of the vehicle.
  • Safety Concerns - Apart from the visible signs of continued UV exposure, your car’s safety can also get compromised. High temperatures inside your car can damage its airbags and other safety systems. Components such as airbags are susceptible to damage if exposed to extreme warmth.
  • Health Issues - Exposure to UV rays can cause premature aging of the skin and signs of sun damage such as wrinkles, leathery skin, liver spots, actinic keratosis, and solar elastosis. UV rays can also cause eye problems. They can cause the cornea (on the front of the eye) to become inflamed or burned.

    Children are at especially high risk of suffering damage from exposure to UV radiation.
